scene.label: Act 3, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. A Room in Gloucester's Castle

lines.text: I will have my revenge ere I depart his house.
lines.plainText: I will have my revenge ere I depart his house

lines.text: How, my lord, I may be censured, that nature thus gives way to loyalty, something fears me to think of.
lines.plainText: How my lord I may be censured that nature thus gives way to loyalty something fears me to think of

lines.text: I now perceive it was not altogether your brother's evil disposition made him seek his death; but a provoking merit, set a-work by a reproveable badness in himself.
lines.plainText: I now perceive it was not altogether your brother's evil disposition made him seek his death but a provoking merit set awork by a reproveable badness in himself

lines.text: How malicious is my fortune, that I must repent to be just! This is the letter he spoke of, which approves him an intelligent party to the advantages of France. O heavens! that this treason were not; or not I the detector!
lines.plainText: How malicious is my fortune that I must repent to be just This is the letter he spoke of which approves him an intelligent party to the advantages of France O heavens that this treason were not or not I the detector

lines.text: Go with me to the Duchess.
lines.plainText: Go with me to the Duchess

lines.text: If the matter of this paper be certain, you have mighty business in hand.
lines.plainText: If the matter of this paper be certain you have mighty business in hand

lines.text: True or false, it hath made thee Earl of Gloucester. Seek out where thy father is, that he may be ready for our apprehension.
lines.plainText: True or false it hath made thee Earl of Gloucester Seek out where thy father is that he may be ready for our apprehension

lines.text: [Aside.] If I find him comforting the King, it will stuff his suspicion more fully. I will persever in my course of loyalty, though the conflict be sore between that and my blood.
lines.plainText: Aside If I find him comforting the King it will stuff his suspicion more fully I will persever in my course of loyalty though the conflict be sore between that and my blood

lines.text: I will lay trust upon thee; and thou shalt find a dearer father in my love.
lines.plainText: I will lay trust upon thee and thou shalt find a dearer father in my love
